$comment: Publish targets of the Otti Colosseum experience: the ALLOWLIST of where a build may go. A target that is not listed here, or whose ids are null / 0 / malformed, is refused before anything is built or uploaded (scripts/release/Validate-Release.ps1). Ids are strings so no tool rounds them. DEV and PROD must match src/shared/ExperienceConfig.luau; STAGING is a separate experience that runs with the DEV environment of ExperienceConfig (its place ids are not configured there, so its servers select DEV data and memory names inside their own universe).

DEV.description: Development experience; private test accounts only

STAGING.description: Pre-release experience for the manual acceptance with several test accounts. NOT CONFIGURED: fill the ids of a separate Roblox experience before the first use.

PROD.description: The public experience. NOT CONFIGURED: the PROD place ids are 0 in ExperienceConfig and unknown here (docs/RELEASE_BASELINE.md, release blocker).
